projects.title: Spotify Song Recommendation System
projects.question: What makes two songs sound alike?
projects.description: Build a music recommendation system that suggests songs similar to a user's input based on audio traits such as tempo, energy, and danceability.

projects.title: Offline & Online Anomaly Detection in Credit Card Data
projects.question: When does a transaction look unusual?
projects.description: Detect fraudulent transactions in credit card data in offline and online settings, working through the anomaly-detection pipeline from batch data to incremental streams.

projects.title: Prompt Model Alignment Evaluation System
projects.question: How can we evaluate a model's response to a prompt?
projects.description: Study how language models interpret prompts, define scoring metrics, and build a pipeline that outputs alignment scores to evaluate model behaviour.

projects.title: Football Analytics
projects.question: What can we learn from a match?
projects.description: Build a data platform to analyze football matches and players, extracting insights from match videos into statistics such as xG models.

projects.title: CineMatch
projects.question: What makes a recommendation relevant?
projects.description: Build a recommendation system that understands user preferences across multiple dimensions and explains its suggestions.
